note: Positive controls: known-good products with real recall identifiers, on pages written in each marketplace's own vocabulary, run through the same path as the sweep (fromstudio.to_raw, normalize.classify, normalize.normalize). Every one must reach RED. `leaked` here means the opposite of the adversarial file's: a control that fell OUT of RED, which is a recall bug and blocks the freeze. The pair is the whole claim. adversarial.json shows the matcher refuses what it should, this file shows it accepts what it should, and a sweep that reaches no RED rows describes the market only if both hold.
limits: 84 of the 84 CPSC notices with an assertable model carry the regulator's full company line in the brand field, for example 'ECHO Inc., of Lake Zurich, Illinois'. Where the notice reads like that, the model control reaches RED only because its page repeats the whole string. A real amazon.com page prints the short brand, normalize.brand_conflict() fires, and the row lands AMBER instead. Safety Gate brands are short, so the DE model control does not depend on this.
The pages are constructed. These controls demonstrate that the adjudicator can reach RED, not that any of these products is on sale anywhere. The only live payload here is the kaufland.de fixture.
